Chapter 626: Chapter 44 Treasure of the Xuanhuang Secret Realm (5000 words, Please subscribe)

“Is it really that simple?” Lin Yuan was somewhat astonished.

He could feel the specialty of the yellow-brown crystal before him.

The breath that faintly connected with the entire Xuanhuang Secret Realm assured Lin Yuan that the Six-Armed Silhouette was not lying.

As long as he refined this yellow-brown crystal, he would inherit the whole Xuanhuang Secret Realm.

Then, even Supreme Beings would not be able to locate the Xuanhuang Secret Realm, which would become Lin Yuan’s backyard.

But—

...

Wasn’t this too easy?

No battles to fight.

No trials to pass.

No obstacles to overcome.

Just like that, he entered the Xuanhuang Secret Realm, arrived at the core area, and obtained all of this?

“Simple?” the Six-Armed Silhouette thought for a moment, “Indeed, it’s simple.”

In fact, the Xuanhuang Emperor had left many challenges and setbacks.

But the Six-Armed Silhouette, having glimpsed part of Lin Yuan’s strength, knew that those challenges and setbacks meant nothing.

So it simply couldn’t be bothered to follow through, directly handing everything to Lin Yuan.

“Your qualification, your talent, are worthy of our Profound Yellow Lineage’s gift,” the Six-Armed Silhouette stated directly.

It was as if it had the words ‘I approve of Lin Yuan’ written all over its face.

“I can sense that the true years you’ve experienced won’t be very long, definitely not exceeding four thousand years.”

“In such a short time, you’ve opened up so many Spatial Layers; such foundation, I have never seen. I believe you have a great chance to become a Twelfth-Rank Life,” said the Six-Armed Silhouette, looking at Lin Yuan.

“The Emperor would be pleased to have a successor like you,” it continued.

“I understand now,” Lin Yuan realized, the Six-Armed Silhouette had been paying attention to him all along.

Of course, as the ‘Heavenly Tao’ of the Xuanhuang Secret Realm, nothing that happened within the realm could be hidden from it.

“What can I do for the Emperor?” Lin Yuan put away the yellow-brown crystal and asked.

“You don’t need to do anything,” the Six-Armed Silhouette said meaningfully, “You just need to remember the ‘Xuanhuang’ Emperor’s name and, in the future, spread the Xuan Huang Evolutionary Path.”

“I know the threshold for cultivating the Xuan Huang Evolutionary Path is high, but it doesn’t matter. With your talent and qualification, you will live a very, very long time; you can do it casually,” the Six-Armed Silhouette added.

“Remember the Xuanhuang Emperor’s name.”

“And spread the Xuan Huang Evolutionary Path?”

Lin Yuan didn’t find it difficult to do, especially since the Six-Armed Silhouette had not set any specific standards, such as specifying how many years he had to achieve this.

This left a very flexible standard, even if Lin Yuan didn’t specifically work on it in the future, there would be no problem.

“Correct.”

“At the Emperor’s level, the concept of life and death no longer exists. As long as descendants still remember his name, and his cultivation method continues to be circulated in the world, perhaps in the extremely distant future, there may come a day when he returns,” the Six-Armed Silhouette spoke with a hint of hope.

“Return?”

Lin Yuan was startled.

Although the Six-Armed Silhouette never said, and the Stone Statue Shen Ji in the Demon Jade Space didn’t come to a conclusion.

But Lin Yuan subconsciously believed that the Xuanhuang Emperor had already perished, and the Moyu Tower Master had also perished.

After all, if he wasn’t dead, why hadn’t he appeared for such a long time? Even if trapped, he should have had some means to make contact with the outside world.

But according to the Six-Armed Silhouette, even if the Xuanhuang Emperor really died, he could return?

‘Return’ meant resurrection.

Supreme Beings could resurrect others, but how could Supreme Beings themselves be resurrected?

The essence of resurrection is to reverse the River of Time, to fish out a life that has perished from time passed and then bring it back to the current point in time.

What about Supreme Beings?

They have already stepped out of the River of Time; the past and present are one and the same. If a Supreme Being dies, it is impossible to resurrect, because there is no life mark of a Supreme Being from the past to be found.

And even if found, who could endure the cost of resurrecting a Supreme Being?

The resurrection of beings by Supreme Beings is not without cost; it’s just that the price is borne by the Supreme Beings themselves. The more powerful the resurrected being, the higher the backlash one has to bear.

Normally, resurrecting an Eleventh Rank Powerhouse is enough to have a significant impact on a Supreme Being, let alone resurrecting a Supreme Being of the same level?

A Supreme Being could also perish as a result.

Though Supreme Beings have eternal lifespans, it doesn’t mean they cannot die.

“It’s just a possibility, the Emperor never took that step,” the Six-Armed Silhouette shook its head and said.

“That step?”

Lin Yuan looked at the Six-Armed Silhouette.

Such a secret is definitely only known at the ultimate level.

“You should know that, within the Evolution Path, lies the Dao of its founder,” the Six-Armed Silhouette began.

“As long as the Emperor’s ‘Dao’ exists, it means the Emperor has not completely perished.”

“Also, the Emperor’s unique name, if remembered, can also serve as a force to assist in the Emperor’s return.”

“So that’s how it is,” Lin Yuan thought to himself, the significance of an ultimate existence was beyond his imagination.

Of course, the Xuanhuang Emperor certainly made significant progress in the ultimate realm, possessing some characteristics that transcended the ultimate, so there was hope for return after death.

It was just unknown whether the Demonic Jade Tower Master had reached that level; the Demon Jade Space was merely an area left by the Tower Master for training.

It is different from the Core of the Secret Realm that hosted the heritage; the former is not the fundamental legacy of the Moyu Tower.

“All right.”

“You’ll need some time to refine the Core of the Secret Realm. Now let me introduce to you the treasures and heritage within this Xuanhuang Secret Realm,” said the Six-Armed Silhouette in a good mood, having found such an excellent successor for the Emperor. Even though this successor appeared rather weak now, there was hope for the days to come.
